_: Expectations are hand-written from composition_rules.json, not recorded from the code. Both the Python composer and its JS mirror run these.

order_sections.why: No tenant order: the page falls to the researched baseline. author_bio(14) before content_block(15), checkout_cta(21) last.
placement:none is NOT filtered here — structured_data is the head-channel JSON-LD and dropping it strips the page's rich results.
The tenant's arrangement wins inside the free band; a section they never placed sorts after everything they did.
Repeatable sections key by element id, so they are never in the baseline; they keep their relative order instead of collapsing.
Bands outrank the tenant: legal_footer is pinned_bottom and cannot be dragged above free content.
hero is pinned_top: it stays above free content no matter what the tenant order says.

order_section_keys.why: The builder's ROW list does drop placement:none — structured_data is not a draggable row.
Baseline governs an unarranged page, same as the sections above.
A key in neither the tenant order nor the baseline sorts LAST, never first.
